loading.comment: I like option 1, but I don't like the month heatmap days, or the progressbar. And in the menu, it's not aligned with the words ("hosts:") so it doesn't look good there either
loading.reply: Option 1 now has the three fixes: in the month heatmap days and the meter, which are already rows of cells, the waiting cursor stands alone; in the menu the written cells sit on the baseline of "hosts:". "The progressbar" could mean two things, so both are shown. Option 2 reads it as the meter: it waits as its own bracketed htop row, [ ], with the cells written inside it by the cursor (option 1 keeps the lone cursor there). Option 3 reads it as the approved spinner and busy bar at the foot of the scene: the same as option 1, with that reference left out so you can judge the parts without it. Options 4 to 7 are the earlier alternatives.
